title: fix(plugin-detail): a highlight chip with no translation is captioned by the field's declared label
body:
Fixes #26417
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么:** 记录页标题下的高亮条(highlight strip),字段没有翻译条目时，每个小标题不再是空白，而是显示对象定义里声明的字段标签(内联多语言标签按当前语言取),没有声明标签时显示字段名;有翻译或视图里写了标签时仍以它们为准。
- **为什么改:** AI 生成的应用和所有没有 i18n 包的对象，记录页高亮条只显示「陈静 | 周明轩」两个值，看不出哪个是所有者、哪个是客户;详情区对同一批字段早已按「翻译 → 标签 → 字段名」显示，高亮条漏了中间一级。
- **风险与回滚:** 低。只改 `HeaderHighlight.tsx` 的小标题取值一处，有翻译或作者标签的页面渲染不变(测试钉住);回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看:** `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/HeaderHighlight.tsx` 中 `caption` 的取值;新测试 `record-highlights.declaredCaption-26417.test.tsx`。
- **两分钟验证:** `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/plugin-detail/src/renderers/__tests__/record-highlights.declaredCaption-26417.test.tsx`,预期 7 个测试全绿。
- **需要你做的:** 无，席位落地。

## What changes

`ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/HeaderHighlight.tsx`: the chip caption was `fieldLabel(objectName, field.name, field.label)`. With no bundle key and no label on the strip entry (every entry the synthesized page hands `record:highlights`, which passes bare names through as `{ name }`), the fallback was `undefined` and the caption rendered as an empty span.

The caption now climbs the details body's ladder, the same rungs in the same order:

1. the bundle's translation (`fieldLabel`, unchanged);
2. the strip entry's own label, when the author wrote one;
3. the label the object declares for the field, read with `pickLocalized` in the session language, so an inline locale map never renders as an object;
4. the field name.

Rungs 2 and 3 are the details body's `withDeclaredLabel` (`renderers/record-details.tsx`) and rung 4 is `DetailSection`'s `field.label || field.name`. `DetailSection.tsx` and `record-details.tsx` are not touched.

The ladder sits in `HeaderHighlight`, not in the `record:highlights` normaliser, because `HeaderHighlight` has two callers: the `record:highlights` renderer and `DetailView`'s `schema.highlightFields`. Both already hand it the object definition, so filling the rung once covers both. It is computed on every render, so a definition that arrives after the record replaces the field-name caption with the declared label. `record-highlights.tsx` gains one comment line that says where a bare name gets its caption.

## Tests

New: `ui/packages/plugin-detail/src/renderers/__tests__/record-highlights.declaredCaption-26417.test.tsx`. Each leg first finds the chip by its value, so an empty caption cannot pass as a strip that drew nothing.

- Bare names on an object with no bundle (zh): `所有者` / `关联客户` (the card's case).
- An inline locale map: `阶段` in zh, `Stage` in en.
- No declared label: the field name, never a blank caption.
- A bundle entry still wins over the declared label, and an unbundled sibling still reads its declared label.
- An authored strip label still wins over the declared label.
- Agreement: the details body draws the same two captions for the same fields.
- Late definition (the `DetailView` path, `HeaderHighlight` mounted directly): the caption is the field name before the definition arrives and the declared label after.

### Red, then green

- Red at `0729de2e` (the test alone, before the fix): `pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-detail/src/renderers/__tests__/record-highlights.declaredCaption-26417.test.tsx` from `ui/` under the verify lock, `VERDICT command-exit 1`, Tests 7 failed (7). Four legs failed on an empty caption (received `''`): bare names, the locale map, the field-name fallback and the late definition. The bundle and authored-label legs passed their first assertion (the bundle entry, the authored label) and then failed on the unbundled sibling's empty caption. The agreement leg failed on its harness: with no name field declared, the details body drops `owner` as the record title. The fix commit switches that leg to `customer` and `stage`.
- Green at `542908d2` (fix plus `origin/main` merged), from `ui/` under the lock: `pnpm exec vitest run packages/plugin-detail --maxWorkers=2` exit 0, Test Files 310 passed and 1 skipped (311), Tests 2876 passed and 18 skipped (2894). `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-detail type-check` (`tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`) exit 0. The new file alone, verbose, Tests 7 passed (7).

`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derived 34 commands. 32 exited 0, including `node scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs` (manifest present and intact, 106 components; no registry contract changed, so nothing was regenerated). `--ran` reconciliation: 34 derived, 33 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.

- NOT MEASURED, `pnpm check:type-check-debt`: exit 3, PREREQUISITE NOT MET. Its closure build queued on the shared verify lock twice and never got a turn. CI's `Lint & Repo Gates` is the reading.
- NOT MEASURED, `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/`: exit 1, but the run was killed with SIGKILL before its summary. Two tests had already timed out at about 18.8 s under box contention: `check-hand-rolled-comment-mask.test.ts` ("exits 0 as a process") and `js-comment-mask-returns-interpolation-9424.test.ts` (the type-check:scripts program). Both test `ui/scripts/`, which this diff does not touch. The first one's subject, `node ui/scripts/check-hand-rolled-comment-mask.mjs`, run directly on this tree, exits 0. CI is the reading.

## Acceptance notes

- `DetailView`'s own `highlightFields` path (`HeaderHighlight` mounted directly) gets the same caption, because the ladder sits in `HeaderHighlight`. The late-definition leg pins it.
- `DetailSection.tsx`, `record-details.tsx` and the locale packs are untouched. No new i18n key.
- The caption ladder now exists in two places: `withDeclaredLabel` in `record-details.tsx` (rungs 2 and 3, filled on the entry) and `HeaderHighlight` (computed at render). The agreement leg pins that both give the same text. Extracting one shared helper would mean editing `record-details.tsx`, which is outside this card's file surface. Carrier: none. Noted here only.
